Nate (People Ops): Quick question 22 Carlos is moving from our SF office to NYC team location on 2027-01-15. He's on H-1B with current LCA tied to CA. Do we need an H-1B amendment before he starts in NY?
Ruth (Eng Manager): Team wants him physically in NYC 1/15 for on-site kickoff. We can be flexible a week if legal needs time.
Carlos (Engineer): I can delay if needed but prefer 1/15. I have no travel/stamping planned  just internal relocation.
Priya (Immigration Counsel): Short answer: yes, a new LCA for the NY worksite is required. An H-1B amendment is generally recommended if the new worksite is outside the metropolitan statistical area (MSA) of the original LCA or if duties materially change. For an inter-state move like SF->NY we should file new LCA and likely a concurrent H-1B amendment.
Priya (Immigration Counsel): We can file the LCA immediately (takes ~7 business days for cert) and then file the H-1B amendment. If timing is tight we can request premium processing for the amendment once filed. Until receipted/approved, Carlos can continue working at the new location only if legal advises that portability rules cover intra-company moves, but safe approach is to wait for receipt or run with manager risk acceptance. I'll prepare recommendation.
Maya (Payroll): Payroll flags: state tax withholding and unemployment/state filings change when he moves to NY. We need his NY address and new W-4 state info by the move date. Also check local benefits tax treatment.
Juno (Benefits): Benefits generally follow employment; we must update commuter/NYC pre-tax transit options and dependent care FSA limits. Medical/dental stays same. If he moves counties, some voluntary benefits may vary.
Nate (People Ops): Action items: 1) Priya file LCA for NY location and advise on amendment / premium processing. 2) Carlos to confirm NYC address and exact start date (1/15). 3) Maya to prepare payroll state change checklist. 4) Juno to note commuter benefit options.
Carlos (Engineer): Confirmed  moving into Brooklyn, address DM'ed via secure form. Start 1/15. If we must wait a week I can start remote that week.
Priya (Immigration Counsel): Received address. I'll submit LCA today and aim to file amendment by end of week. Recommend we request premium processing for amendment; cost center please confirm. If manager ok, I'll proceed.
Ruth (Eng Manager): Approve premium processing. Please proceed.
Maya (Payroll): Received address. I'll prepare state withholding update and NY onboarding checklist. Expect a short payroll ticket to sign.
Nate (People Ops): Great  I'll mark offer/Greenhouse location update and add note: "pending H-1B amendment LCA filing; premium processing requested."
hr-bot: Reminder: upload any scanned documents via secure HR portal. Do not post PII in channel.
Priya (Immigration Counsel): Update: LCA certified (ETA): 2026-12-22. I'll file amendment with premium processing and post receipt when received.
Carlos (Engineer): Thanks team  1/15 still good. Appreciate the quick turnaround.
Nate (People Ops): Closing loop: Priya please post receipt and expected decision ETA; Maya & Juno proceed with payroll/benefits changes for NY. We'll reconvene if any hold needed. Thanks!
